title: Popping Dance Tutorial with Dey Dey | How to Pop for Beginners | @RedBullDance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains isolation techniques methodically by breaking down each body part with close-up demonstrations. She uses vivid visual imagery and physical guidelines to emphasize control, muscle engagement, and precision.

lesson_structure.note: Dey Dey introduces herself and the topic of popping techniques

cues: control and focus where you want to pop
metaphors: break something that's in your hands
punch the floor like with the heel
common_mistakes: using shoulders or elbows instead of focusing energy in the wrist
breaking the wrist into a motorcycle motion
safety: do not push your knee back too hard or you will hurt your knee

steps_taught.name: Wrist pop
steps_taught.description: Hit an imaginary wall using wrist energy without shoulder or elbow movement

steps_taught.name: Triceps pop
steps_taught.description: Isolate and contract the triceps muscle without turning arms

steps_taught.name: Leg pop (back and front)
steps_taught.description: Contract quadriceps and glutes or heel push while keeping foot on the floor

quotes.text: The idea is to hit a imaginary wall
The most important thing is to really focus your energy in your wrist
One important thing in popping is the technique
So the muscles do the movement

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates wrist isolation from the side against an imaginary vertical line overlay
Instructor points to triceps muscle while executing a pop demonstration

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down popping exclusively into micro-movements of specific isolated joints using physical visualization metaphors like hitting a wall or breaking an object
